title: Three Mornings and One Short Chair
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：interview　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 interview 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the manager ① held the interview that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the holding was the whole of the morning. The ② interview, meaning the meeting itself and not the chair, ran three mornings and stayed unrecorded in the book; an interview, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ interview in that office had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ interview at the far door, meaning the answer they kept for the children to repeat and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An interview, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the manager said the recording is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the interview was the whole of the matter, meaning the chance and not the meeting. The ⑥ interview, meaning the chance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; interview, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a meeting and a chance. He said the chance is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ interview had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ interview of the whole thing, the manager wrote in April, was one office and three mornings of recording; interview, he said, is either the answer at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ interview I remember is the meeting recorded in the note, which closed in 1999 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. An ⑩ interview, my mother said in 2001, is the only meeting that improves by being recorded; every interview, she said, is a chance that has agreed to look like a meeting. She said the chance was the honest half.

answers.why: hold the interview 意为“举行这场面试”，1992 年那位经理把办公室里没有一位应聘者肯记录的一场面试做了一遍。
interview 意为“面试；面谈”，指那场面谈本身而不是座椅，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被记录。
interview 意为“面试；面谈”，指办公室里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一把小小的座椅。
interview 意为“面试；面谈”，指最远那扇门边留给孩子们复述的一个那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
interview 意为“机会、际遇”，指一件事里人人都面却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次机会就是那件事的全部。
interview 意为“际遇”，指人人都面却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场面谈，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
interview 意为“面试；面谈”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一场，到 1997 年这一场成了记录里的一行。
interview 意为“求职之事”，经理四月写道，整件事的面试之事是一处办公室和三个早晨的记录。
interview 意为“面试；面谈”，我记得的是记录里记录过的那一场，1999 年结束了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一场。
interview 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，面试是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的面谈。
